scientific_integrity: Exhaustive integer matrix/kernel-sign enumeration and direct rational witness; novelty best knowledge only, older Pauli-rank formulation remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for noncyclic G=F_2^2, self-STFT and noiseless support; no general group theorem, no all-support spectrum or quantitative stability. General minimum support and stabilizer classification are prior results.
title: A sharp self-Gabor support gap on the Klein four group
